cards.answer: Rumble is an AP fighter-mage who deals sustained magic damage with frontal flames and a lingering, slowing fire field. Heat empowers his basic abilities, while overheating temporarily disables his abilities and strengthens his attacks.
cards.counterplay: Move out of his flames and keep your distance from his empowered attacks.

cards.answer: Electro Harpoon damages the first enemy hit with magic damage, slows them, and reduces their magic resistance. Rumble stores charges; repeated hits stack and refresh the slow and magic resistance reduction, and Danger Zone strengthens its damage and debuffs.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the harpoons or use minions as cover; back away after a hit to limit follow-up pressure.
